title: Implement hydration management API
description: POST /admin/hydrate to trigger hydration job. GET /admin/hydrate/{task_id}/status for progress. Admin key authentication.

title: Implement AI question generation background job
description: Celery task that uses OpenAI API to generate questions per chapter. Prompt engineering for theme, facts, characters, emotions, morals questions. Generates 10 questions per chapter with 4 choices each (1 correct, 3 plausible distractors). Includes 'none of the above' / 'all of the above' variants.

title: Implement book data hydration background job
description: Celery task that fetches top 100 books per age group (6-18) from web sources. Parses book metadata (title, author, ISBN, description, age range). Stores in database with deduplication on ISBN.

title: Build profile page
description: Profile page showing book progress cards with attempt history, scores, and continue/retake buttons. Stats summary (total quizzes, questions answered).

title: Implement user profile API endpoint
description: GET /users/me/profile returns all books user has attempted with scores, attempts, and remaining questions. GET /users/me/books/{id}/progress returns detailed progress for a specific book.

title: Build quiz-taking page
description: Quiz page showing one question at a time with progress bar. Multiple-choice selection. Correct/incorrect feedback after each answer. Final score display. Guest email capture flow.

title: Implement quiz start and answer API endpoints
description: POST /quizzes/start selects 10 random unanswered questions. POST /quizzes/{id}/answer records answer and returns correctness. POST /quizzes/{id}/complete finalizes attempt and returns score. Support both authenticated and guest flows.

title: Build landing page with search
description: Landing page with hero section, large search bar, and featured/example books. Search results displayed as book cards. Responsive design. Write Playwright acceptance test FIRST.

title: Implement book search API endpoint
description: GET /api/v1/books with query parameter for fuzzy search on title and ISBN. Pagination. Response includes book metadata and question count. Write acceptance test FIRST.

title: Set up React frontend skeleton with routing
description: React app with react-router-dom routes for all pages. Layout component with Header. Zustand store for auth state. React Query provider. Tailwind CSS setup.

title: Implement authentication system
description: JWT-based auth with /auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/refresh endpoints. Password hashing (bcrypt), token generation/validation, user model. Include rate limiting on auth endpoints.

title: Implement core FastAPI application skeleton
description: Create FastAPI app with CORS, error handlers, request ID middleware, health check endpoint (/api/v1/health). Structured logging with structlog.

title: Create database schema and migrations
description: Implement all tables from DATA_MODEL.md: users, books, questions, choices, quiz_attempts, quiz_answers. Include GIN trigram index for book search. Create Alembic migration.

title: Set up project repository structure
description: Create backend/ and frontend/ directory structures. Initialize Python venv, npm project, Docker Compose, pre-commit hooks. Verify 'make dev' starts both servers.
